definitions.explanation: Describes a relaxed, unhurried state of mind or manner, especially remaining calm and unperturbed regardless of circumstances. Often implies a dignified ease.

examples.japanese: {悠然|ゆうぜん}と{構|かま}える
{彼|かれ}は{悠然|ゆうぜん}とした{態度|たいど}で{答|こた}えた。
examples.english: He answered with a calm, composed demeanor.

examples.japanese: {周囲|しゅうい}が{騒|さわ}いでも、{彼女|かのじょ}は{悠然|ゆうぜん}と{読書|どくしょ}を{続|つづ}けていた。
examples.english: Even as those around her were making a fuss, she calmly continued reading.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective/adverb. Most commonly used adverbially as {悠然|ゆうぜん}と.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {悠然|ゆうぜん}と (calmly, leisurely, composedly)

NUANCE: {悠然|ゆうぜん} suggests an elegant, dignified calmness with an unhurried quality. It implies being above petty concerns and maintaining composure with grace.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悠然|ゆうぜん}と{構|かま}える (to remain unruffled)
- {悠然|ゆうぜん}とした{態度|たいど} (composed demeanor)
- {悠然|ゆうぜん}と{歩|ある}く (to walk leisurely)

RELATED WORDS:
- {泰然|たいぜん} (calm, unperturbed - similar but emphasizes steadfastness)
- {悠々|ゆうゆう} (leisurely, at ease)
- {落|お}ち{着|つ}いた (calm, composed)
